title: Native finite-stage open tensor datum existence
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, schemes X and Z in universe u, and an open immersion j:X -> Z. Fix n in N. At the positive quotient stage n+1, with the actual StrictTower.moduleJ, modulePullback, native adjunction and finitePullSection of [def-coef-native-open-tensor-evaluation-data], there exists an ordinary/cochain datum of [def-sf-open-tensor-cochain-data], namely NativeOpenTensorPrimitives.FiniteOpenCochainsData l E j n of [def-coef-native-open-tensor-primitives]. No sequence-site datum or family over n is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0GL1, separating the sequence-site and finite coefficient constructions.

proof.text: Use the existing unique native ordinary pullback tensor comparison at the fixed constant ring compactSupportSystemLevel l E n. Its section equation is definitionally the equation for finitePullSection; its two-variable naturality gives pullNaturality. Take the native module direct image and adjunction for the right adjoint.

Realize native module inverse image as the algebraic inverse-image module functor followed by the specified change of rings. Apply ringed-topos preservation of flat-term K-flat complexes. Transport along the equality of functors to obtain both pullKFlat and pullFlat.

Tensoring an extended module by an arbitrary ambient module remains in the essential image of native extension. The native open unit is invertible, so extension is fully faithful and its counit on this tensor is invertible. Define p as the transpose of unit tensor identity followed by inverse pullback tensor comparison. This adjunct is invertible, and p is extension of that adjunct followed by the invertible counit, hence is invertible. Define ordinary as (asIso p).symm. The adjunction hom equivalence proves ordinaryInverse; naturality of the unit and pullback tensor comparison proves naturality of p, hence of its inverse.

Make the ordinary isomorphisms into an isomorphism of curried bifunctors. Apply the proved generic comparisonPrecompose_exists totalization helper: extension preserves the countable coproducts because it is a left adjoint. Its inclusion equation gives summand after inverting the comparison, and its two-variable chain naturality gives chainNaturality after inverting the comparison.
